verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Metronome stores raw billing/revenue-recognition data and can export data to a warehouse for building reports with 'your favorite data tools' — i.e., analytics are explicitly bolted-on via external BI, not computed natively as MRR/churn/cohort/LTV dashboards. No evidence of native MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV metrics computed inside Metronome itself.
